analyst.text: Philadelphia go for a sixth straight win; Jaylen Brown (hamstring), Dean Wade and Adem Bona are all listed probable. Portland have lost three of four, blew a late lead on a Mikal Bridges buzzer-beater in New York, and Damian Lillard said 'we can't let this trend continue'; Ja Morant remains out. Portland are mid six-game road trip and frustrated, so the angle leans Philadelphia.
